entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I, uh, I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the cycling shoes I bought. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I've always loved your gear, but these... they're just not working. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels.
Oh, that sounds incredibly uncomfortable. Blisters can certainly ruin a ride. Let me pull up your order information. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF78-1138. I just... I saved up for these and I really needed the money back if they didn't work out. It's a shame.
I understand completely, Sarah. Thank you for that information. Okay, I see the order here for the Aero-Vent cycling shoes, delivered 32 days ago. Let me just check our policy.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Since the cycling shoes are a standard item, they fall under our 90-day return policy. You are well within that window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. We want you to be happy with your gear. I also see here that you're a VIP member with us, Sarah. We truly value your loyalty. As a thank you, I've gone ahead and made your return shipping label complimentary, and I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase. I'll email you the return instructions right now. You'll get your refund as soon as the warehouse processes the return.
Wow, Alex. That's so kind of you. You've really turned my day around. Thank you so much for making this so easy.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
